app.title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop for macOS and Windows
app.author: Kuyawa
app.description: A native desktop client that allows users to run DeepSeek LLM models locally or via the cloud, providing a chat interface and prompt management.
proposed_tests: Download the precompiled binaries for macOS and Windows from the releases page.
Launch the application and verify the UI loads without errors.
Connect to the DeepSeek API endpoint (local or cloud) and send a test prompt, measuring round‑trip latency.
Export a conversation to a text file and import it back, checking consistency.
